Activity2 Target Numbers Add Tenths or Hundredths: both partners start at0, roll the number cube, decide whether to add drawn number of TENTHS or HUNDREDTHS, keep a running total for SIX turns and aim as CLOSE to1 AS POSSIBLE WITHOUT EXCEEDING1. There is no fixed winning total; original dice results, independent moves and discussion of alternate move require TEACHER_REVIEW_REQUIRED.
